speaker: counselor
text: Last time you mentioned a job offer. How did that go?

speaker: student
text: They want me to start next week, twenty hours, but I am scared to take it.

speaker: student
text: I heard if you work off campus you can lose your visa. I do not understand what is allowed and what is not, and everyone tells me something different.

speaker: student
text: I keep thinking one wrong shift and I will be sent home. I can't sleep.

speaker: counselor
text: Have you asked the international office?

speaker: student
text: I went once. They said to read the website. The website says one thing and my friend says another.

speaker: student
text: My parents send what they can. Without this job I will have to skip meals at the end of the month. But I am not allowed to work this many hours, so I have to say no.
